name: great-chamber
audit: Keep both routes around the central hoist separate from its blocked body. Cut the two uprights, crossbar and boiler/wheel silhouette, retaining the holes. Every changed tile is listed below with its previous value and reason. Silhouettes replaced with full-resolution SAM ViT-H object masks; see sam_source and per-piece prompts. SAM silhouette review restores 10 additional reachable floor tiles: floor behind the raised near doorway post and its hanging lantern; keep the post base and stored barrels solid.
